latin: Qui nescierit perfecte sensibiles proprietates per uiam secretae analogiae intellectualizare, nihil ex hymnis Orphei sanum intelliget.
translation: Without the skill to render sensible properties fully intellectual by the method of hidden analogy, one will draw nothing sound from the Orphic hymns.
